title: OpenSU texture sets
description: Built-in photographed PBR texture sets with a real-world size, named by materials (extras.texture). Images in textures/<id>/, made by scripts/textures.mjs. See packages/core/src/looks/textures.ts.

source.description: Where the photographs come from; only CC0 sets are accepted

polyhaven.description: A Poly Haven texture id: scripts/textures.mjs downloads it

size.description: What one image covers, mm [w, h]

unit.description: One tile, brick or board of the photo with its joint, mm: a material with a pattern scales the set so its own unit fits

neutral.description: The colour map is stored in greys; all colour comes from the material

maps.description: Written by scripts/textures.mjs: paths under textures/

arm.description: Ambient occlusion, roughness, metalness in R, G, B (glTF)

average.description: Written by scripts/textures.mjs: the colour map's average linear colour
